d:
This is the new 2027 Chevrolet Corvette Grand Sport, and might it be the sweet spot in the C8-generation ‘Vette family? Its naturally aspirated V8 might have less than half the power of the Corvette ZR1X, but the new 6.7-litre engine still has more power than a Porsche 911 GT3. Plus there’s the wider body from the Z06, the kudos of not being the entry-level Corvette Stingray, and even specced handsomely it's less than the cheapest 911. It’s America’s budget supercar then, but might it be America’s best supercar too?
2027 Chevrolet Corvette Grand Sport
Ollie Kew
